en: Ah, {player}! Forgive me. I was in such a hurry that I left you behind.
I've opened the door of Sky Pillar. Now, let's go!
An earthquake! We haven't a moment to spare!
Even here, the weather has gone wrong. {player}, Rayquaza should be at the very top of this tower.
I'm worried for Sootopolis. I must go back. Everything rests with you now. Don't let us down!
Sky Pillar... Rayquaza must be at its top. Let's hurry!
